title: Figure Demand Feature Vectors
description: One record per Japan anime/figure SKU: identity, prices, supply, provenance and a 48-dimensional normalized feature vector.

schemaVersion.title: Schema Version
schemaVersion.description: Feature-vector schema version (semver). Breaking layout changes bump the major.

featureDim.title: Feature Dimension
featureDim.description: Length of the ordered vector; always matches featureNames length.

demandScore.title: Demand Score
demandScore.description: Composite supply-side demand proxy in [0,1]. Not a back-tested forecast.

history.title: History Provenance
history.description: Number of distinct collection snapshots observed for this SKU and whether velocity features are meaningful.

coverage.title: Upstream Coverage
coverage.description: Which parts of the upstream row actually carried data. Per-shop features are only trustworthy when hasOfferDetail is true.

features.title: Named Features
features.description: Feature name -> normalized value. Keys follow the canonical order in featureNames.

featureNames.title: Feature Names
featureNames.description: Canonical ordered feature names; index i corresponds to vector[i].

vector.title: Ordered Vector
vector.description: Fixed-length float vector in featureNames order.
